verdict.rationale: LanceDB's own storage layer is documented to run on local NVMe, EBS, EFS, or any S3-compatible object store, so users decide where their data physically lives. Region or residency control follows only indirectly from the storage target the user picks. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the managed Enterprise/Cloud offering, data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: That design makes it flexible enough to run across local NVMe, EBS, EFS, and any object store that exposes an S3-compatible API.
LanceDB's storage layer is built on modular, disk-first components
